QuoteProvider.reason: Prices and splits from Yahoo Finance; the Yahoo adapter (#6) fills quotes, splits, dividends and assets.

DividendProvider.reason: Dividends from Yahoo Finance; the Yahoo adapter (#6) fills them with the quotes.

FundamentalsProvider.reason: Yearly fundamentals from StatusInvest; the adapter is built (#8)

StatementProvider.reason: Financial statements from CVM ITR and DFP; the CVM statements adapter (#11) fills them per company, with the consolidated and individual versions, and the period-aware load (#28) reads only the years of the period. A stock ticker maps to its CNPJ through the CVM company list (#28).

FundDataProvider.reason: Monthly FII data from the CVM monthly fund files (#28): net worth and the balance columns, one row per reference month, with the version and the files. StatusInvest (#8) is built, but the site blocks requests from this server, so its columns that CVM does not carry stay null.

FilingProvider.reason: Filing list from the CVM IPE file (#9), the ITR, DFP and FRE datasets (#11) and the CVM eventual fund file for FIIs (#28). A stock ticker maps to its CNPJ through the CVM company list; a FII ticker maps through the curated list, and any other ticker fails with a named pending error.

DocumentProvider.reason: Filing documents (PDF and HTML) from CVM through www.rad.cvm.gov.br, and the FII reports from FNET (fnet.bmfbovespa.com.br) when CVM links them (#28); the CVM document adapter (#10) downloads them per filing, with a size limit and a host list.

MacroProvider.reason: Macro series from BCB SGS; the BCB adapter (#7) fills ipca, cdi, selic, ptax and igpm (SGS 189).

TreasuryProvider.reason: Tesouro Direto prices and rates (daily history from 2004) from the Tesouro Transparente file; the Tesouro adapter fills treasury_prices for one bond family per load.

ExpectationsProvider.reason: Annual market expectations from the BCB Focus survey (Olinda); the Focus adapter fills market_expectations for ipca, selic, pib_total and cambio.

IdentifiersProvider.reason: A ticker's CNPJ and ISIN from the B3 listing and detail routes; the B3 listing adapter fills asset_identifiers, and CVM uses it for a FII outside its curated list.

RegistryProvider.reason: A company's legal name, sector and situation from CVM's company file (cad_cia_aberta); the CVM registry adapter fills company_registry.

FxProvider.reason: The closing PTAX rate of a currency per day from the BCB Olinda service; the PTAX adapter fills fx_rates.

FundProvider.reason: A fund's registry, daily quota and holdings from CVM's open files, keyed by the fund CNPJ; the fund adapter fills fund_registry, fund_daily and fund_holdings.
